Messages.Body:

The prime vamp for you is Rebecca, Chantry Elder of Munich:

Tremere, Cap 8, AUS PRE THA, +1 stealth on all of her actions
(She is no sabbat, though. But you may use Clan Impersonation if you
really want to make her sabbat)

For a search of your other vamps, check

http://pcs.cnu.edu/~jtullner/jyhad/disc-match.txt

Choose your set of disciplines, and in that text-file you find the vamps
matching.

2) can

> vamps (and vice versa) or participate in any way in a hunt of non-sabbat
> vamps?
> thanks for your help....jason <all...@wcnet.org>

The sabbat (correct me please if I am wrong) has no card like Imperial
Decree/Convenant of Blood which are cards for NON-CAMARILLA vs.
CAMARILLA. You cannot use them for Sabbat because Sabbat is a sect and
Non-Camarilla is a collective term for the four independend clans.

You CAN use War Party (the sabbat equivalent to the Blood Hunt Action),
which enables you to attack nearly ALL vampires (not only Camarilla). In
fact, you can attack every vamp except Archbishops, Prisci and
Cardinals.

--

i think you're talking about blood hunts/ wild hunts? if so, blood and
wild hunts are the same thing, and a "generic" hunt can be called by any
methuselah when any vampire is diablerised (except in cases like that
pander where it's not allowed, and muaziz..) regardless of whether the
victim was sabbat or not or whether you control a sabbat or not.

> The sabbat (correct me please if I am wrong) has no card like Imperial
> Decree/Convenant of Blood which are cards for NON-CAMARILLA vs.
> CAMARILLA. You cannot use them for Sabbat because Sabbat is a sect and
> Non-Camarilla is a collective term for the four independend clans.

sure you can. there are two sects: sabbat and camarilla. the four
independant clans are just that, independant. they are not sabbat, and
not camarilla. so if a card says "non-camarilla" it means just that, not
a camarilla. so they could be independant or sabbat vampires to be
eligable for the "non-camarilla" bit. thus making the card "closed
session" actually useful for camarilla voting decks.
if a card says "non-sabbat" then it applies to the four independant
clans, plus camarilla clans..

> CAMARILLA. You cannot use them for Sabbat because Sabbat is a sect and

Non-Camarilla is a collective term for all clans that are not Camarilla
clans. It includes the four Independent clans as well as all Sabbat

> Also, what effects does it have if a vampire is non-Camarilla /
> Camarilla ?

In addition to any restrictions/effect listed in card text:

Vampires who are not Camarilla vampires:

Cannot become Princes or Primogen. [SAB]
Cannot call Praxis Seizures, Justicar Retribution, Command of the Harpies,
Masquerade Enforcement, nor a vote to burn Elysium: the Arboretum. [RTR]
Cannot call Camarilla Exemplary. [TOM 951227]
Cannot call a vote to burn Masquerade Enforcement. [TOM 960206]
Can call any votes not listed above. [TOM 960102]
Cannot be chosen as an Archon or Camarilla Exemplary. [RTR]
Suffer the effects of blocking an Archon or Camarilla Exemplary. [RTR]

Vampires who are not Sabbat vampires:

Cannot become Bishops, Archbishops, Prisci, or Cardinals
Cannot call Crusades

Messages.Author: Justin Grace
Messages.Body:
In article <338146...@leila.ping.de>, Michael Beer
<Mi...@leila.ping.de> writes

>The sabbat (correct me please if I am wrong) has no card like Imperial
>Decree/Convenant of Blood which are cards for NON-CAMARILLA vs.
>CAMARILLA. You cannot use them for Sabbat because Sabbat is a sect and
>Non-Camarilla is a collective term for the four independend clans.

Non-Camarilla means not a member of the Camarilla. Thus, it applies to
all Independents AND to all Sabbat.

Covenant can be played by Sabbat vampires of the right capacity, and
Camarilla vampires can attack Sabbat with an Imperial Decree.
--
Pax Vobiscum
